description: Change a webhook endpoint's URL, subscribed events, description or enabled flag; fields left out keep their value. Disabling keeps the endpoint but stops deliveries: events raised while it is off are dropped, queued deliveries fail, and nothing is replayed when it is switched back on. The signing secret stays the same and is not returned - rotate_webhook_secret issues a new one. Returns the updated endpoint.

enabled.description: false stops deliveries - events raised meanwhile are dropped, not queued; true starts them again

events.description: Replaces the whole subscribed list (use list_webhook_event_types for the names)

url.description: New https URL to deliver to

name: update_webhook
title: Update webhook
